subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): add timeouts to model discovery requests

question: Should Amazon Bedrock control-plane discovery enforce the proposed fixed 30-second deadline for each foundation-model and inference-profile request?
rationale: The patch correctly prevents indefinite waiting, but selecting the threshold determines when slow yet valid AWS responses become empty-catalog or omitted-profile outcomes and therefore requires Bedrock owner intent.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Land the focused provider-local timeout because it bounds setup and refresh stalls without adding another configuration surface or changing the established fallback shape.

options.title: Select a different fixed deadline
options.body: Keep the implementation shape but adjust the constant and associated proof to an owner-selected operational budget before merge.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Leave discovery unbounded until maintainers define a broader provider-discovery deadline policy, accepting the existing indefinite-stall risk meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Land the focused provider-local timeout because it bounds setup and refresh stalls without adding another configuration surface or changing the established fallback shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the inference-profile discovery behavior whose production availability contract is being changed.
